name: .400 Cal-300gr Stone Hammer®
note: Minimum required twist rate is 1-17″ for big game hunting and 1-15″ for dangerous game hunting, or faster. Recommended use: Big Game Hunting and Dangerous Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This is a great mid weight bullet, designed for the 400 Tembo, suitable for any big game, plains game, or dangerous game hunting. A great combination of velocity and retained weight for deep straight line penetration."
